title: Project Assistant
qualification: M.Sc. in Horticulture/ Agriculture/ Fruit Science/ Genetics & Plant Breeding
salary: Project Assistant: Consolidated emoluments of ₹25,000/- per month
age_limit: Project Assistant: Below 35 years. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC as per Govt. of India norms.

title: Village Level Worker (VLW)
qualification: B.Sc. in Agriculture or Horticulture from an ICAR-recognized University or Institute. Candidates holding an M.Sc. in any discipline of Agriculture or Horticulture must mandatorily also possess a B.Sc. in Agriculture or Horticulture.
salary: Selected candidates will be placed in Level-9 of the Pay Matrix under the Sikkim State Subordinate Agriculture Service. During the period of Probation/Apprenticeship/Training, pay shall be governed as per Notification No. 489/GEN/DOP dated 31.10.2011.
age_limit: Minimum age: 18 years || Maximum age: 40 years || Age will be reckoned as on 31 August 2026, the closing date of application, as per Notification No. M(3)/(55)/GEN/DOP/Pt.III dated 03.07.2017.
application_fee: Candidates need to pay an application fee of ₹200/- online through Net Banking, or Credit/Debit Card (Visa/MasterCard). The fee once deposited will not be refunded or adjusted against any other purpose.
selection_process: Written Examination — as per the scheme and pattern given in Appendix-I of the official notification. || Document Scrutiny — candidates who qualify in the written examination will be called for verification of original/attested documents on dates specified by the Commission. || Candidates are advised to download the detailed syllabus and exam pattern from the official SPSC website before beginning preparation.
